model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different model variants. The x-axis represents the number of completions (*k*), displayed on a logarithmic (base-2) scale ranging from 2⁰ (1) to 2⁸ (256), with tick labels at each power of two. The y-axis represents coverage, on a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.4 to 0.9, with gridlines at 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. Four lines are shown. The dark blue solid line with circular markers represents "Llama-3B," starting at approximately 0.43 at k = 1 and rising steadily to approximately 0.90 at k = 256. The green dashed line with triangular markers represents "Llama-3B + FT," starting at approximately 0.45 at k = 1 and increasing to approximately 0.88 at k = 256, following a trajectory close to but slightly below the Llama-3B line at higher k values. The light blue solid line with circular markers represents "Llama-1B," starting at approximately 0.40 at k = 1 and rising to approximately 0.83 at k = 256. The light green dashed line with triangular markers represents "Llama-1B + FT," starting at approximately 0.42 at k = 1 and increasing to approximately 0.82 at k = 256, tracking closely with the Llama-1B line throughout. All four lines exhibit a monotonically increasing trend with a concave shape, showing steeper gains at lower values of k that gradually flatten at higher values.
